description: Preview and edit draw.io, Mermaid and PlantUML (UML) diagrams inside VS Code.
command.preview.openToSide: Open Diagram Preview to the Side
config.drawio.url: URL of the draw.io embed app. Point this at a self-hosted draw.io (e.g. `http://localhost:8080/`) to work offline or keep diagrams inside your network.
config.drawio.theme: Light/dark mode of the draw.io editor. `auto` follows the VS Code color theme.
config.mermaid.theme: Mermaid theme. `auto` picks `default` or `dark` based on the VS Code color theme.
config.markdown.mermaid: Render ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in the built-in Markdown preview.
config.plantuml.render.auto: Use a local plantuml.jar when `#drawGraph.plantuml.jar#` is set, otherwise the PlantUML server.
config.plantuml.render.local: Always render with a local plantuml.jar (requires Java).
config.plantuml.render.server: Always render with the PlantUML server (diagram source is sent to the server).
config.plantuml.server: PlantUML server URL used for server rendering. The diagram source is sent to this server — use a self-hosted server for private diagrams.
config.plantuml.jar: Absolute path to `plantuml.jar` for local rendering.
config.plantuml.java: Java executable used for local PlantUML rendering.
config.plantuml.dot: Optional path to the Graphviz `dot` executable for local PlantUML rendering.
config.preview.debounce: Delay in milliseconds before the preview updates after an edit.
config.drawio.svgColorScheme: Colors of SVG images written by the draw.io editor (`*.drawio.svg` files and **Export as SVG**). Applies the next time the diagram is edited or exported.
config.drawio.svgColorScheme.auto: Adaptive (draw.io default): the image switches to dark colors when the viewer (GitHub, browser, OS) is in dark mode.
config.drawio.svgColorScheme.light: Always the light colors you see in the light editor.
